metadata.name: Wait for part of a web page
metadata.author: recued-core
metadata.description: Use “Wait for part of a web page” in Recued. Wait in a page until something shows, such as the results after a search or a message after saving, or until it goes, such as a loading spinner. Answers found true, or found false when it did not happen in time, and what changed on the page. Opens the page first if no tab shows it.

page.help: The page's address, such as https://example.com/orders, whether a tab shows it or not: with none showing it, the page is opened in a new tab first, which asks you unless allowed on that site. Or a page handle a listing, an opening, a read or an action answered, copied exactly.
page.label: Page

text.help: Wait until what matches also holds this text, such as Saved. Case and spacing are ignored. Leave it empty to wait for the element alone.
text.label: Text

until.help: shown waits until something that matches is shown; gone waits until nothing that matches is.
until.label: Until

selector.help: A CSS selector for what to wait for, such as #results or .toast. Any shown element that matches counts.
selector.label: Part of the page

timeout_seconds.help: How long to wait at most, up to 30.
timeout_seconds.label: Seconds
